hello.title: Hi! I'm Chai
hello.text: I'll help you start speaking English, without cramming or boring textbooks.

lessons.title: 5 minutes a day
lessons.text: Short lessons matched to your level, from A1 to C1. XP and a daily streak keep you going.

talk.title: Speak out loud
talk.text: AI teachers are available 24/7. They correct mistakes gently and switch to Russian if you get stuck.

install.title: Add Talkreal to your Home Screen
install.text: It will open like a regular app.

home.levelDoneText: You have finished every lesson at this level. Ready for the next one?
home.noLessons: Lessons for this level are coming soon.

mascot.morning: Good morning! Five minutes of English and the day starts right.
mascot.day: Hi! A good moment for a short lesson.
mascot.evening: Good evening! Shall we end the day with a couple of new phrases?
mascot.streak_one: {{count}} day in a row! Keep it up.
mascot.streak_other: {{count}} days in a row! Keep it up.

talk.title: Teachers
talk.subtitle: Live voice conversations are coming very soon. Meanwhile, meet the team.
talk.subtitleLive: Pick a teacher and talk out loud. They hear you, answer by voice and gently correct mistakes.
talk.noTime: You have used today's speaking time. Come back tomorrow!

harper.style: Warm and precise. Explains a rule so that it finally sticks.

jake.style: Relaxed and fun. Small talk, slang and phrases from real life.

elena.style: Explains in Russian when it gets hard. Ideal if you're just starting.

sterling.style: Interviews, calls and negotiations. Clear and to the point.

install.title: Install the app on your iPhone
install.step1: Tap the Share button at the bottom of the screen

login.title: Log in to Talkreal
login.subtitle: Enter your email and we'll send a code. No password needed.

errors.expired: The code has expired. Request a new one.
errors.too_many_attempts: Too many attempts. Request a new code.
errors.wait: A code was already sent. Check your email.
errors.too_many: Too many requests. Try again later.
errors.email_failed: Couldn't send the email. Try again later.
errors.consent_required: To create an account, please tick the privacy policy box.
errors.telegram_unavailable: Telegram is not available right now. Please try later.

login.telegramWaiting: Press Start in Telegram and come back here. You'll be logged in automatically.
login.consent: I agree to the processing of my personal data and accept the

placement.title: What's your level?
placement.subtitle: It decides which lessons you see. The test takes a couple of minutes, or you can pick your level yourself.
placement.resultText: We've matched the lessons to this level. You can always change it in your profile.

A1.name: Beginner
A1.hint: I know some words and simple phrases

A2.name: Elementary
A2.hint: I can talk about myself and follow simple speech

B1.name: Intermediate
B1.hint: I get by when travelling and follow the gist

B2.name: Upper-intermediate
B2.hint: I speak confidently on most topics

C1.name: Advanced
C1.hint: I speak fluently and want to polish the details

lesson.vocabHint: Tap the speaker to hear the pronunciation.
lesson.exitText: Your progress in this lesson will not be saved.
lesson.limitText: You have used today's free lessons. Come back tomorrow and your streak will continue. Unlimited lessons are coming with Pro.
lesson.errorText: Check your connection and try again.

speak.tap: Tap the microphone and say the phrase aloud.
speak.again_one: I didn't catch all of it. {{count}} try left.
speak.again_other: I didn't catch all of it. {{count}} tries left.
speak.blocked: No access to the microphone. Allow it in your browser settings or skip the exercise.
speak.failed: Speech recognition is not available right now. Try again or skip the exercise.
speak.missed: Listen to the phrase again and repeat it after the speaker. This exercise will come back at the end.

summary.lessonComplete: One more step towards fluent English.
summary.streakHint: Study every day to keep it growing.

review.cardText_one: {{count}} word or mistake is ready to repeat
review.cardText_other: {{count}} words and mistakes are ready to repeat
review.emptyText: Words and mistakes from the lessons you finish will appear here when it is time to recall them.
review.exitText: Your answers in this session will not be saved.

call.intro: Tap the button and just start talking.
call.transcriptHint: The conversation text will appear here.

ended.limit: You have used today's speaking time. Come back tomorrow!
ended.max_duration: The conversation reached the maximum length. You can call again.
ended.unavailable: Conversations are unavailable right now. Try again later.
ended.provider_error: Couldn't connect to the teacher. Try again.
ended.provider_closed: The connection dropped. Try calling again.
ended.mic_denied: No access to the microphone. Allow it in settings and try again.
ended.connection: No connection. Check your internet and try again.

freeze.label: Streak freezes
freeze.usedHint: You missed yesterday, but the streak goes on.
freeze.earnedHint: It keeps your streak if you miss one day.
freeze.frozenText: You missed yesterday. Do a lesson today to keep the streak.

reminders.title: Reminders
reminders.needChannel: Choose where reminders go: Telegram or a notification on this phone.
reminders.pushOn: Notifications are on for this phone
reminders.pushDenied: Notifications are blocked. Allow them for Talkreal in your phone settings.
reminders.pushUnsupported: Notifications are not available on this device. Connect Telegram instead.
reminders.pushNeedsInstall: To get notifications on iPhone, add Talkreal to your Home Screen and open it from there.
reminders.testSent: Sent. It will arrive in a few seconds.
reminders.testNone: Could not deliver it. Connect Telegram or turn on notifications.
reminders.testWait: Please wait a little before trying again.

perfect.name: Flawless
perfect.text: Finish a lesson without a single mistake.

streak_3.name: 3 days in a row
streak_3.text: Practise three days in a row.

streak_7.name: One week
streak_7.text: Practise seven days in a row.

streak_30.name: One month
streak_30.text: Practise thirty days in a row.

level_done.name: Level complete
level_done.text: Finish every lesson of your level.

first_call.name: First conversation
first_call.text: Talk to an AI teacher for at least half a minute.
